prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity direction-decision comp for a Chrome extension side panel
Primary request: Design one complete CueWave OPERATE interface called “像素工作台”. It must make the rapid workflow obvious in one glance: add a semantic probe, analyze the current YouTube video, scan the semantic timeline, then open a hotspot to verify the original sentence. This is a real, implementable software screen, not concept art or a marketing poster.
Scene/backdrop: The entire image is the UI itself. No device frame, no browser frame, no desktop wallpaper, no surrounding scene.
Style/medium: A rigorous early one-bit desktop system translated into a shippable 2026 Chrome side-panel UI. Pure black and warm off-white pixels with only ordered-dither gray. One-pixel window chrome, square corners, hard dividers, tiny pixel icons, bitmap-pattern fills, inversion for active and selected states, compact Geneva/Chicago-like hierarchy, disciplined 8-pixel rhythm. Crisp 1-bit raster edges at every scale. Dense, quick, legible, and unmistakably operational.
Composition/framing: Portrait 440×960-ish. Use one continuous application workbench rather than modern floating cards. Top system title bar; a compact current-video strip; a dominant add-probe command field; a short probe list; then two tightly stacked internal windows titled “语义时间轴” and “最高热点”. Keep the add-probe field and the analysis result visible together. The timeline is the main visual field and must read as real data, with a horizontal 00:00–18:42 axis and vertical intensity bars. Hotspot rows sit immediately below and are clearly clickable. Bottom utility strip is compact and subdued.
Text (verbatim): Render the following Chinese interface copy accurately and do not add slogans or claims: “CueWave”, “已连接”, “当前视频”, “为什么我们会被算法影响？”, “18:42”, “输入你想在视频里寻找的内容…”, “+添加探针”, “语义探针”, “知识科普”, “幽默程度”, “推广信息”, “字幕已就绪”, “分析视频”, “语义时间轴”, “00:00”, “04:18”, “11:32”, “16:05”, “18:42”, “最高热点”, “原句核对”, “字幕来源”, “定义编辑”, “历史”, “成本”. The selected probe is “知识科普” and its full row is black with white inverted text. Use 04:18, 11:32, and 16:05 as the three ranked hotspot timestamps; each has a short Chinese evidence excerpt and a compact “原句核对” action.
State language: Distinguish four timeline states strictly with native one-bit grammar: analyzed intensity = solid black bar height; low value = sparse ordered dither; unanalysed = diagonal 1-bit hatch; failed = dense cross-hatch with a small exclamation mark. Include a tiny legend inside the timeline window so these states are honest and unmistakable. No state is represented by color.
Controls: The input is a crisp inset one-pixel command box with a blinking-style square caret. “+添加探针” and “分析视频” are square system buttons with black border and tactile one-pixel pressed-state logic. Probe visibility uses tiny pixel checkboxes, never colored chips. Window title bars and selected rows use black/white inversion. All times use tabular bitmap numerals.
Color palette: Strictly #FAFAF5 warm off-white, #111111 black, and #BDBDB5 only through crisp ordered dithering—no continuous gray rendering and absolutely no additional colors.
Materials/textures: One-pixel black rules, one-bit bitmap icons, ordered Bayer-like dither, diagonal hatch, cross-hatch, tiny scroll arrows, compact menu-bar typography. Dither remains crisp and geometric, never film grain or noise.
Constraints: Preserve the exact current-video, probe, timeline, and hotspot content above. Keep every Chinese label readable. Make the hierarchy compact but generous enough for touch/click targets in a 440px-wide side panel. All components must look feasible in HTML/CSS. No invented accuracy, speed, user-count, completion, privacy, vendor, or public-release claims. No logos beyond the text name CueWave. No watermark.
Avoid: gradients, glass, blur, shadows, rounded cards, rounded pills, floating modern panels, colorful accents, soft grayscale, 3D bevels, skeuomorphic plastic, neon, generic dashboard cards, oversized headings, marketing copy, illustrations, maps, trains, people, phones, laptops, browser chrome, fake analytics, illegible pseudo-Chinese, decorative retro stickers, or a loose “retro skin” over modern UI.
